request.style: English, cinematic orchestral pop ballad, warm expressive male baritone lead vocal, clear intimate storytelling in the verses, soaring lyrical chorus following the supplied Vocal melody, nostalgic and hopeful, serene autumn atmosphere, acoustic grand piano, lush legato strings, warm acoustic bass, gentle restrained drums, subtle French horn swells in the final chorus, spacious polished studio production, F major, 88 BPM, follow the supplied meter changes, instrumental introduction, gradual emotional build, tender resolved ending Follow the supplied melody and chord progression. Sing the Vocal part; piano and orchestra play the Ins passages and accompaniment. Natural legato phrasing and clear diction, with breathing between phrases.
request.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Morning in the Harvard Yard

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse]
Sunlight warms the old brick walls

[Instrumental Break]

[Chorus]
Hold us here beneath the starlight

[Instrumental Break]

[Chorus]
In the quiet soft light

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse]
Books lie open on the grass
Laughter floats beneath the trees we chase the day

[Instrumental Break]

[Chorus]
Red brick buildings keep our stories when our footsteps fade
Let our love stay

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse]
Someone saves a place for me
We trade our dreams beneath the shelter of a tree

[Instrumental Break]

[Bridge]
Year by year another spring brings voices here
Strangers turn to lifelong friends and learn to start again

[Chorus]
Hold us here a little longer where the roots of love grow strong
In the Yard we learned belonging let our stories stay
When I walk these paths once more old friends come back to me
Harvard Yard beneath your trees all our love stays here

[Outro]
